quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Oklahoma City Thunder's playoff loss to the San Antonio Spurs
quotes.excerpt: The healthier team wins. So if Shai Gilgeous-Alexander was hurt last year against Oklahoma City, do they win?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: I told y'all, the majority of the time, the healthier team wins. So if Shai Gilgeous-Alexander was hurt last year against Oklahoma City, do they win?

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: With the Knicks, they were healthy.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: The importance of having multiple playmakers in the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: You have to have two to three guys that can go get you a bucket.
quotes.quote: At the end of the day, I have kept the same energy about everything. You have to have two to three guys that can go get you a bucket. They did not have that and I told y'all that is going to hurt them at the end of the day. They are not going to win if those guys are not healthy.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's performance in the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander had one of the worst performances for an MVP in 70 years.
quotes.quote: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander had one of the worst performances for an MVP in 70 years. It is the largest fall-off from a regular season to a postseason for any MVP history behind Larry Bird.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: The necessity of having multiple playmakers to win a championship
quotes.excerpt: You cannot win a championship with one guy. Regardless of how good the team is.
quotes.quote: You cannot win a championship with one guy. Regardless of how good the team is, regardless how your bench players are, you have to have another guy that can create. As great as Shai Gilgeous-Alexander played, you have to have like Jalen Williams, your Chet Holmgren, your Victor Wembanyama. Those guys have to come to the party.
